title: About Payvay
content: Payvay is licensed by the State Bank of Pakistan (SBP) as an Electronic Money Institution under the EMI Regulations.

title: Scope
content: These Terms of Use govern the opening and closure of your Payvay Account and the use of Services available on the Payvay Platform.

subList.subTitle: Registration
subList.subContent: Users must be at least 18 years old and have legal capacity to accept these terms.

subList.subTitle: Nature
subList.subContent: The Payvay Account is not a bank account or a deposit; it holds E-Money that does not earn interest.
Maintain the security of your Payvay Account.
Promptly notify Payvay of any unauthorized access or security breaches.
Payvay is not liable for indirect or consequential losses, including loss of profit, business, or reputation.
Payvay does not endorse the quality, safety, or legality of goods or services purchased through its platform.
Payvay may terminate your account with two months' prior notice.
Immediate termination may occur if there is suspicion of unauthorized or fraudulent use.
